events.info: "Brown's music is multilayered, his dexterity and guitar mastery produces jamming beats, while maintaining the fluidity, of a stream flowing over rocks... His expressions as he grooves the music out of his instrument are priceless, sometimes revealing an element of surprise at his own virtuosity," raves ALL ABOUT JAZZ (Live Performance Review).
events.pleaseNote: Multi-Platinum Selling, GRAMMY® Award-Winning, Multi-GRAMMY® Nominated & Chart-Topping Jazz Guitarist NORMAN BROWN has sold over 2 million albums in his extraordinary career and virtually lives at the top of the Billboard Contemporary Jazz Charts. He has had 15 acclaimed albums in the Top 5 on the Billboard Contemporary Jazz Chart, with 5 albums hitting the #1 position! Brown has been thrilling international audiences for over four decades with his jaw-dropping virtuosity, soul-stirring performances, and gravity-defying technique. The exultation that emanates from his riveting performances is hard to resist. It is no surprise that the iconic George Benson calls Brown, "One of the greatest and most articulate guitarists out there." ALLMUSIC raves, "A master player and improviser." JAZZ TIMES states, "A culmination of Jimi Hendrix and George Benson with some of Wes Montgomery thrown in." Get ready to experience Norman Brown's live performance masterpiece with his Acclaimed Band!

events.name: Nickel-A-Dance: Don Vappie & The Creole Jazz Serenaders
events.info: Nickel-A-Dance: Don Vappie & The Creole Jazz SerenadersNickel-A-Dance is a free, family-friendly jazz concert series in New Orleans, celebrating the city's rich musical heritage. Founded in 1994, it features top local jazz musicians performing classic jazz, blues, and swing. Originally held at Café Brasil on Frenchmen Street, the series now takes place at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro on Sundays from 3:00--6:00 PM. The event is open to all ages and aims to make live jazz accessible to everyone. Don Vappie is a world renowned jazz musician and bandleader from New Orleans. He leads the Créole Jazz Serenaders, a classic New Orleans jazz orchestra, as well as his various jazz and R&B combos. He has produced and recorded numerous albums and film soundtracks, and is star of the PBS documentary "American Créole: New Orleans Reunion." Known for his virtuosic banjo skills, Don is also a stellar bassist, guitarist and vocalist. Add to that his commitment to the preservation and perpetuation of the cultural créole music of New Orleans he calls "créole jazz." Vappie was also awarded the 2021 Steve Martin Banjo Prize, and was inducted into the Banjo Hall of Fame in 2022. This is a free progam with no ticketing. Just come ready to dance. For more info on Nickel-A-Dance, visit: https://www.nojc.org/nickel-a-dance Shows from 3-6pm Doors at 2:30pm

events.name: The Walrus and The Electric Yat Quartet present a Beatles Experience
events.info: "Hands down, one of THE BEST Beatles bands I've ever seen, and I've seen a lot of 'em. Do yourself a favor and see The Walrus," says Chuck Gunderson (Author of "Some Fun Tonight: The Beatles Historic Tours of 1964-1966").
events.pleaseNote: The Walrus is not your typical Beatles cover band, there are no wigs, fake accents, or gimmicks. Just four of New Orleans' most seasoned musicians performing some of the greatest songs ever written, purely for the love of the music. From Beatlemania-era favorites like "I Want to Hold Your Hand" to psychedelic classics like "Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds," rockers like "I Saw Her Standing There," and beloved ballads like "Blackbird," The Walrus delivers faithful renditions with their own unmistakable New Orleans flair. Another New Orleans based band, the Electric Yat Quartet brings a fresh, energetic approach to classical, jazz, rock and pop music. With both acoustic and electric capabilities and training in classical and jazz, the quartet is known for versatility and dynamic performances and collaborations. Come enjoy the Beatles Experience with these world-class musicians, classic songs, and the unmistakable spirit of New Orleans!

events.name: Gerald Watkins Jr. presents A Birthday Tribute to Art Blakey
events.info: Gerald Watkins Jr. presents A Birthday Tribute to Art BlakeyCelebrate the birthday and enduring legacy of legendary drummer and bandleader Art Blakey with New Orleans drummer, percussionist, educator, and mentor Gerald Watkins Jr. Born October 11, 1919, Blakey was the driving force behind the legendary Jazz Messengers and one of the most influential figures in the history of hard bop. His powerful drumming and commitment to mentoring young musicians helped shape generations of jazz artists. Leading an all-star New Orleans ensemble, Watkins brings Blakey's spirit of swing, groove, and musical mentorship to the stage. A versatile and highly respected drummer, Watkins has performed with Delfeayo Marsalis & the Uptown Jazz Orchestra, Dee Dee Bridgewater, Eric Benét, Ledisi, and other acclaimed artists. He is also a dedicated educator and mentor at the Ellis Marsalis Center for Music, continuing Blakey's tradition of nurturing the next generation of jazz musicians. Join us for an evening celebrating the music, legacy, and unmistakable groove of Art Blakey! events.info: Charmaine Neville BandCharmaine Neville, daughter of legendary saxophonist Charles Neville of the Neville Brothers, carries the torch of a rich New Orleans musical legacy. While she is rooted in the city's vibrant traditions, Charmaine brings her own unique voice to the stage, blending R&B, Jazz, and world rhythms into a sound that's all her own. Her performances are a reflection of the city's spirit---bold, diverse, and deeply soulful. Renowned for her high-energy live shows, Charmaine and her band captivate audiences with an infectious sense of joy and a strong emphasis on audience participation.
